race.comment: SCOOBARTIE (2) is in fine form, backing up the dominant maiden win here two back (at $1.35) with another easy victory at Seymour, coming from off the pace and going on to score by 2.25 lengths. Brad Rawiller sticks again and he can keep the ball rolling. DA NANG STAR (1) might be the danger. His past two here have been very good, in higher grade last time behind a subsequent Swan Hill winner. He'll get first run on the favourite and that aids his cause. SEA TRADER (3) is going well and is unbeaten this trip. Should run another honest race. POINT MOON (11) resumes as a lightly raced filly. She did win her maiden well fresh last campaign and has the upside to challenge here, respecting.
